system.description:
Cursed item (seems a Bag of Holding). It works as one, but coins, gems and precious metal left in it overnight turn to lead, glass and quartz.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
An ordinary-looking sack lined with extradimensional space. It holds up to 8 slots' worth of items, and its contents add nothing to your slot count or encumbrance. Drawing out a specific item takes an action.

Rarity: Rare
